insights.one_liner: High-tech systems and parts maker for chip, healthcare and analytical industries, with Dutch sites around Eindhoven and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: Frencken Mechatronics develops and builds complex high-tech systems and components for semiconductors, healthcare and analytical technology.
Says safety, quality and continuous improvement are central to how it works.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Frencken Machining B.V. and Frencken Mechatronics B.V.

growth.text: Plans to raise S$100 million by placing shares, to fund expansion and possible acquisitions.
First-half 2026 net profit fell 3.4% to S$19.3 million, but it expects higher revenue in the second half.
Broke ground on a new facility in Singapore.

worth_knowing.text: The group wants to be known for more than semiconductors, according to a profile interview.
